rule: An integer block target (x,y,z) is verified at (x+0.5, y, z+0.5): horizontal block CENTER, integer foot Y unshifted. Rejected when the 3D squared distance from the live position to that point exceeds tolerance^2 (tolerance 0.75, comparison is strictly greater-than, so exactly 0.75 passes). Shared by Java CPlusE3G3TerminalContract.arrivalPoint and Python cplus_e3_g3_terminal.arrival_point; both self-tests must agree on every vector. Boundary vectors use dyadic values (exact in binary) so no epsilon is needed.
